note: Plate profiles for Workflows. Pick one per labware; it is pinned into the workflow. height_to_volume is [[height_mm_above_well_bottom, volume_ul], ...]; calibrated_low_gap_mm is how far calibrated low sits above the well bottom. Volume checks run only when both are set; otherwise they report 'not measured'. Add plates by appending entries.
